summary: @rpondiscio @MichaelPetrilli @dr_ddennis bill gaining steam in CT wanting 12 credits of reading instruction in ECE teacher prep. I oppose (we have 10.5 plus field work /placement). I can find 0 studies equating credit hour to student performance. Do you know of any?
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @rpondiscio @MichaelPetrilli @dr_ddennis bill gaining steam in CT wanting 12 credits of reading instruction in ECE teacher prep. I oppose (we have 10.5 plus field work /placement). I can find 0 studies equating credit hour to student performance. Do you know of any?
